author: JonnyBones
text:
It’s funny that you blame Gable’s loss on my “negative energy.” Meanwhile, I’m an undefeated fighter living the absolute American dream. Before he was caught, our guy had finished every opponent in the first round. Your logic doesn’t make any sense.

I also find it funny that you, of all people, are commenting on my supposedly negative energy. I travel the world alone and get mobbed by fans, while you need full-time security in your own country.

You come out once a quarter to do an interview about me and what a terrible person I am. Boy, you’re obsessed with me. A blind man could see that.

We started off in the same dorm room, yet I’ve earned and achieved literally ten times more than you have.

I genuinely hope that one day you start to feel better. It sucks to even have to address you. … again
